summary: Iteration_9 RE-VERIFY of iteration_8 fixes. ALL 7 fixes pass live against trades.demo and hospitality.demo logins. FIX1 /addons/api-keys: page renders without red-screen, toggling 'CREATE KEY' opens the form with the 'Integration target' chip group populated ('generic' chip visible) and no '... is not a function' error. FIX2 /library/documents, /library/policies, /library/forms all render the correct titles ('Document library' / 'Policy library' / 'Form library') with 'Open on web' button (testIDs lib-documents-open, lib-policies-open, lib-forms-open present); no 'Process library' default leak. FIX3 /safety/swms renders the friendly 'Available on web' Card (testID safety-swms-open present); no 'Unknown safety module' backend body and no Inspections chrome leak. /safety/inspections still mounts the IndustryListShell with title 'Inspections' and the Site/Vehicle subtitle. FIX4 /addons/tradecheck no longer prints 'of undefined' — when stats.total is missing the subtitle falls back to 'Verified credentials marketplace.' FIX5 /hospitality/temperature-logs opened by trades.demo surfaces the friendly 'You don't have access to this feature on this account.' card; the raw 'Request failed (403)' / 'Not authenticated' / 'Not authorized for this feature' strings are no longer present. FIX6 /capture for trades.demo and hospitality.demo both render the 'Other industries' section with 4 LockedTile cards (testIDs capture-locked-{trades|hospitality|transport|healthcare|retail} all present for the other-4 industries each). FIX7 /settings/onboarding mounts without an 'api.put is not a function' runtime error; api.put method is now exposed in src/api/client.ts. REGRESSION: trades amber #FFA630 confirmed visually on Capture chrome; hospitality #E11D48 visible on Capture eyebrow; admin warning #FFCC00 unchanged (no edits to that screen); industry-switcher testID present at app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:110; expo-notifications web warning is the only console warning (carry-over, NA). Hospitality.demo login (flaked in iter 8) succeeded cleanly this run — landed on home, /capture and /hospitality/temperature-logs both mount without red-screen. No new red-screen crashes seen on any tested route.

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over web-only warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' — emitted on every page load. NA for native build. Reference: src/lib/push.ts via app/_layout.tsx.
Carry-over 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning — emitted by react-navigation/ResourceSavingView, not by our code. Will resolve on a future react-navigation upgrade.
